15 open-source Amazon Alexa and Echo projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Amazon Alexa and Echo smart speakers and Fire TV. 12 of 15 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: alexa_media_player, EchoMuse, ha-bridge, echo-dot-assist, techo5.

  • Custom Firmware · 6
  • Smart Home & IoT · 5
  • Productivity · 3
Search and filter in the full index →
  1. alexa_media_player★ 2,007 · active · Python

    This is a custom component to allow control of Amazon Alexa devices in Home Assistant using the unofficial Alexa API.

  2. EchoMuse★ 1,499 · active · Python

    Replacement firmware and controller turning the Amazon Echo Dot 2nd gen into a local Alexa-free device

  3. ha-bridge★ 1,486 · slowing · Java

    Emulates a Philips Hue bridge to control other systems from Alexa

  4. echo-dot-assist★ 1,281 · active · C

    Turn Amazon Echo devices into local Home Assistant voice satellites, replacing Alexa

  5. techo5★ 749 · active · Go

    Open Alpine Linux firmware for Amazon Echo Show 5 (gen 1/2): no Alexa, local Home Assistant voice satellite

  6. echolocal★ 590 · active · Go

    Turns an Echo Dot 2nd gen into a fully local Home Assistant voice satellite

  7. alexa-remote-control★ 464 · active · Shell

    control Amazon Alexa from command Line (set volume, select station from tunein or pandora)

  8. techo5-dot★ 277 · active · Python

    Linux firmware for Amazon Echo Dot 2nd gen replacing Fire OS, as a local Home Assistant voice satellite

  9. python-androidtv★ 198 · slowing · Python

    Communicate with an Android TV or Fire TV device via ADB over a network.

  10. homebridge-alexa-smarthome★ 184 · active · TypeScript

    Exposes Alexa-connected devices to HomeKit via the unofficial Alexa API

  11. node-red-contrib-amazon-echo★ 141 · active · JavaScript

    Node-RED nodes that emulate a Hue bridge for local Amazon Echo control without Alexa Skills

  12. alexa-remote★ 102 · active · JavaScript

    Node.js library to control Amazon Alexa devices through the unofficial Alexa web/app API

  13. lineageos-echo-show-camera★ 86 · archived · C

    Camera and Bluetooth enablement for LineageOS on the Amazon Echo Show

  14. techo5-spot★ 52 · active · Python

    Linux firmware for Amazon Echo Spot 1st gen replacing Fire OS, as a local Home Assistant voice satellite

  15. echo-dot-crumpet-research★ 39 · active · Python

    Reverse engineering research on the Amazon Echo Dot 3rd Gen Refresh
